name: Reconstruction Topology Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare a bounded reconstruction-topology phase and freeze admissible terminology before introducing reconstruction-accessibility structures.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The reconstruction topology phase permits the formalization of bounded accessibility, neighborhoods, and corridors as governance-only analog indicators for projection systems.
phase_definition.non_escalation_rule: No topology object or accessibility relation may be treated as ontologically primitive or physical proof.

governance_rules.rule: Reconstruction topology defines accessibility, not identity.
All topology constructs must maintain NON_PHYSICAL and ANALOG_ONLY status.
Accessibility relations do not imply source equivalence or reversibility.
Conflict preservation is a mandatory requirement for all reconstruction neighborhoods.
Any claim that recoverability implies ontology equivalence must fail validation.

forbidden_claims: Topological alignment eliminates the need for loss accounting.
